test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Town C is to the south of Town A. Town D is to the west of town A. Town B is to the east of town D. Town E is to the south of town B and south-east of Town C. What is the position of town A with respect to town B?
solution:
Given: 

Town C is to the south of Town A.

Town D is to the west of town A.

Town B is to the east of town D.

Town E is to the south of town B and south-east of Town C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d8914089941cb8520c657c14a82f8caaa6f2ad72b92d03c45508714789e70bd2.png] 

So, Town A is at the **West **direction with the respect to Town B.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
